host_role: Firmware upload/reset and read-only diagnostics. Independent ASN.1 identity/schedule verification on the PC did not feed any result to the board. No host time or decoded time was supplied.
crc_provenance: SIB1 bytes were emitted only after onboard SI-RNTI CRC16, transport CRC24, and core SIB1 parsing succeeded. Independent pycrate checking verifies the emitted payload identity and schedule, not raw RF CRCs.
coverage_limitations: 66 nominal centers at 2.5 MHz spacing within reachable WCS/PCS/AWS ranges; not a complete 100 kHz LTE raster survey
Lower LTE bands outside the current direct-tuning backend were not tested
Only FDD normal-CP, 50-RB, four-port, Ng=1 cells can reach the current SIB/time path; other decoded MIB profiles remain operator-unidentified unless SIB1 is recovered
Short sampling dwell, RF fading and cell profiles can prevent identification; lack of reception does not establish lack of an AT&T signal or time broadcast

restoration.method: App-only esptool write_flash at 0x10000 with write hash verified
